SELECT GRP_CD, GRP_CD_NM, GRP_CD_DESC, SYS_DIV_CD, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DT FROM TB_COM_GRP_CD
AND UPPER(GRP_CD) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{grpCd}) || '%'
AND UPPER(GRP_CD_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{grpCdNm}) || '%'
AND USE_YN = #{useYn}
ORDER BY GRP_CD ASC
SELECT GRP_CD, GRP_CD_NM, GRP_CD_DESC, SYS_DIV_CD, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT, MOD_USER_ID, MOD_DT FROM TB_COM_GRP_CD WHERE GRP_CD = #{grpCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COM_GRP_CD ( GRP_CD, GRP_CD_NM, GRP_CD_DESC, SYS_DIV_CD, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{grpCd}, #{grpCdNm}, #{grpCdDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sysDivCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'COM'), COALESCE(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), #{regUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COM_GRP_CD SET GRP_CD_NM = #{grpCdNm}, GRP_CD_DESC = #{grpCdDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYS_DIV_CD = COALESCE(#{sysDivCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYS_DIV_CD, 'COM'), USE_YN = COALESCE(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, USE_YN, 'Y'), MOD_USER_ID = #{modUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE GRP_CD = #{grpCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COM_DTL_CD ( GRP_CD, DTL_CD, DTL_CD_NM, DTL_CD_DESC, SORT_ORD, ATTR_VAL1, ATTR_VAL2, ATTR_VAL3, ATTR_VAL4, ATTR_VAL5, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{grpCd}, #{dtlCd}, #{dtlCdNm}, #{dtlCdDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1), #{attrVal1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attrVal2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attrVal3, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attrVal4, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attrVal5, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), #{regUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COM_DTL_CD SET DTL_CD_NM = #{dtlCdNm}, DTL_CD_DESC = #{dtlCdDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SORT_ORD = COALESCE(#{sortOrd, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SORT_ORD, 1), ATTR_VAL1 = #{attrVal1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATTR_VAL2 = #{attrVal2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATTR_VAL3 = #{attrVal3, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATTR_VAL4 = #{attrVal4, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATTR_VAL5 = #{attrVal5, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, USE_YN = COALESCE(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, USE_YN, 'Y'), MOD_USER_ID = #{modUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE GRP_CD = #{grpCd} AND DTL_CD = #{dtlCd}
